clue.text: Knocking back colourful drink leads to death

indicators.note: knocking back a drink is downing it, but here it tells us to read the drink phrase backwards

parts.note: red is a colour, so colourful gives red
rum is a spirit, a drink

explanation.surface: A drinker's lurid tipple proves fatal after one too many.
explanation.walkthrough: RED RUM, a 'colourful drink' (and a famous racehorse), read backwards gives the letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Murder is a killing, a deliberately caused death, so the noun stands for it.

clue.text: Tiny particle supporting large amount

parts.note: to be pro something is to support it
a ton, informally, is a lot of something

explanation.surface: Something minute is propping up a heavy load.
explanation.definitionFit: A proton is a subatomic particle found in every atomic nucleus, so it is tiny indeed.

clue.text: Dealer in old stuff: dodgy cars and torn parchment

indicators.note: dodgy means unreliable or not right, so the letters of cars are out of order
torn parchment is ripped up, so its letters are broken into a new order too

explanation.surface: A shady trader sells battered cars and ripped old documents.
explanation.walkthrough: Both 'dodgy' and 'torn' signal a mix-up; together CARS and PARCHMENT give all thirteen letters as one pool.
explanation.definitionFit: A scrap merchant buys and sells discarded metal and junk, the old stuff others throw out.

clue.text: Some sidelines in food store

indicators.note: some of the word sidelines means only part of its letters, a run inside it

explanation.surface: A shop sells a few extra lines on the side.
explanation.definitionFit: A deli, short for delicatessen, is a shop selling prepared foods such as cold meats and cheeses.

clue.text: Item of furniture was cut down and border reshaped

indicators.note: cut down means shortened, so the word was loses its last letter
reshaped means given a new form, so the letters of border are rearranged

explanation.surface: A piece of furniture was trimmed and its edging remodelled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut down' trims WAS to WA; 'reshaped' turns BORDER into RDROBE.
explanation.definitionFit: A wardrobe is a tall cupboard for hanging clothes, a standard piece of bedroom furniture.

clue.text: I'm a long time producing pictures

parts.note: taken as written without its apostrophe
ages, informally, is a very long time

explanation.surface: An artist confesses to taking forever to produce paintings.
explanation.definitionFit: Images are visual representations, such as photographs or paintings, which are pictures.

clue.text: End of French is captured by the writer

parts.note: de is the French word for of

indicators.note: captured by means held inside, so is goes within the writer's word

parts.note: the writer refers to the setter, who calls themselves me
taken as written

explanation.surface: A French conclusion is recorded by an author.
explanation.walkthrough: 'End' looks like it means a last letter of French; it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Demise is death or the ending of something, so it can stand for an end.

clue.text: Am I to get TV subscription being friendly?

parts.note: taken as written, run together
cable television is a paid subscription service

explanation.surface: Someone wonders if a cable TV package will make them sociable.
explanation.definitionFit: Amicable means good-natured and peaceable, behaving in a friendly way.

clue.text: Half of county? Certainly not all

indicators.note: half of says we keep only the front four of the eight letters

parts.note: Somerset is a county in south-west England

explanation.surface: Only part of a county is involved, not the whole.
explanation.walkthrough: SOMERSET is a county in south-west England; its first half gives the letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Some means a part or a portion, which is by implication less than the whole.

clue.text: Mistakenly reports e.g. wine as something benefitting drivers

indicators.note: mistakenly means wrongly, so these letters are put in a wrong, new order

explanation.surface: A news item gets it wrong, calling wine good for motorists.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters of REPORTS and EGWINE together rearrange to give the phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Power steering is a car system that makes turning the wheel easier for the motorist.

clue.text: After church one's converted and selected

indicators.note: after says the church abbreviation comes in front of the rest
converted means changed into another form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: After a service, someone undergoes a religious conversion and is picked out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'converted' suggests religion, fitting 'church', but it signals that ONES is rearranged into OSEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Chosen and selected both mean picked out from among others.

clue.text: Significant flat component of phone?

parts.note: key means of crucial importance, significant
a pad is informal for a flat or apartment

explanation.surface: An important piece of a telephone lies flat.
explanation.definitionFit: A keypad is the panel of buttons on a phone used for dialling numbers.

clue.text: Article dropped by dirty relative

indicators.note: dropped by means let go of, so the article is taken away from the word for dirty

parts.note: unclean means dirty
an is the indefinite article used before a vowel

explanation.surface: A grubby family member drops a piece of writing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Article' looks like a piece of writing; it is the grammatical article AN, dropped from UNCLEAN.
explanation.definitionFit: An uncle is a parent's brother, so a family relative.

clue.text: Attracting work for cartoonist

definitions.meaning: a sketch or picture produced in pencil or ink is what a cartoonist makes

explanation.surface: A cartoonist's piece draws people in.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both pulling in, as with a crowd, and a picture made with lines.

clue.text: Computer memory hit hard

definitions.meaning: random access memory, the working memory of a computer, is abbreviated this way

explanation.surface: A computer's memory takes a heavy blow.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is the abbreviation for random access memory and a verb for striking with force.

clue.text: Some outcrop reveals bird

parts.note: part means some of something
a ridge is a long raised strip of land or rock

explanation.surface: A rocky outcrop shows a bird when partly uncovered.
explanation.definitionFit: A partridge is a plump game bird of fields and hedgerows.

clue.text: Different parent blowing top

indicators.note: blowing one's top is losing one's temper, but here the word loses its top, first letter, in a down entry

parts.note: a mother is a parent

explanation.surface: A parent loses their temper, unlike usual.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blowing top' suggests a fit of anger; in a down answer it means losing the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Other means not the same, alternative or distinct from what is mentioned.

clue.text: Writer enthralled by wrestling picked up anthology

indicators.note: enthralled by means held captive within, so the writer goes inside
picked up means lifted, so in a down entry the word for wrestling reads upwards

parts.note: sumo is Japanese wrestling
a nib is the tip of a pen, a writer

explanation.surface: An author captivated by a wrestling bout buys a collection of stories.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down answer 'picked up' means read upwards, giving OMUS; a nib is the pen tip, standing for any writer.
explanation.definitionFit: An omnibus is a single volume collecting several works, so an anthology.

clue.text: Riotous bash, as held in victory? Some clean-up occurs here

indicators.note: held in means contained, so the mixed letters and as go inside the victory word

parts.note: a win is a victory

indicators.note: riotous means wild and disorderly, so the letters of bash are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A wild victory party ends with some tidying up afterwards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Riotous' gives ASHB; the definition is a cryptic hint at a place for washing up, not tidying after the party.
explanation.definitionFit: A washbasin is a sink where people wash their hands and face, a place for cleaning up.

clue.text: Large old woman sitting on insect

indicators.note: sitting on says, in a down entry, the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: old woman is slang for mother, and mam is a dialect word for mother
a moth is an insect

explanation.surface: An elderly lady has sat on a bug.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective, mammoth means huge or enormous, from the extinct giant elephant.

clue.text: Offering little, lyre is replaced after start of music

indicators.note: after says the rearranged letters follow the opening letter of music
start of means the first letter of the word music
replaced means put back in a new position, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A musician swaps out a lyre at the start of a piece but gives little.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is' looks like a link word but belongs to the fodder: 'replaced' rearranges LYREIS into ISERLY.
explanation.definitionFit: A miserly person is stingy and grudging, so offers very little.

clue.text: A selection of matches showcasing game

indicators.note: A selection of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A sporting highlights show presents a game.
explanation.definitionFit: Chess is a board game for two players with kings, queens and pawns.

clue.text: Obsession shown by fellow I initially admired

parts.note: a fellow is a man

indicators.note: initially means take the first letter of the word admired

explanation.surface: A man confesses to an obsession with someone he admired.
explanation.definitionFit: Mania is an excessive enthusiasm or craze, an obsession.

clue.text: The Spanish King gets a deer

parts.note: el is Spanish for the
K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A Spanish monarch acquires a deer.
explanation.definitionFit: The elk is a large species of deer, called moose in North America.
